text:
deploybot: release-check FAILED for release/2026-03-21 - env parity: keystore path encoding + trailing-slash mismatch between staging and prod. Key lookup failing in prod. See check output below.

deploybot: check_summary:
 - staging.keystore_path = "s3://redwood-keystore/prefix/keystore/"
 - prod.keystore_path = "s3://redwood-keystore/prefix/keystore"
 - prod keystore objects encoded as base64 values vs staging plaintext (deploy-time encoding diff)
 - affected service: inference-runtime, route: /resolve-key

nelson: :eyes: is this the thing that caused the canary errors this morning?

emma: yes, we saw 503s from canary (inference-runtime) with logs complaining about missing key suffix. The code expects trailing slash-normalized path when looking up s3 keys.

sarah: how did this get into staging only? I thought keystore provisioning was handled by the same template.

release-eng: template change landed in infra repo but a helmvalues override in prod masked it (prod shipper still using legacy keystore path without slash). Deploybot picked it up because release-check compares normalized values.

nelson: can we hotpatch prod to add normalization shim? Or do we rollback the release? Current image tag: release-2026-03-21-aaa111 (new) vs previous release-2026-03-18-9f2b (known good).

emma: quick options:
 - rollback to previous image tag (fast, safe)
 - hotpatch runtime to accept both variants (risky during window)
 - run db/s3 backfill to add missing trailing slash keys in prod and re-run release (non-blocking but takes ~30m)

release-eng: what about secrets encoding? staging stored plaintext values for a tiny set of keystore items; prod stored base64 encoded values. That affects the backfill job — it needs to decode/encode correctly.

ops-bot: recommended action: HOLD promotion to prod until either backfill completes or image rollback done. Change window ends in 55 minutes.

nelson: I'm leaning to rollback the image and open a follow-up to fix the provisioning + backfill. Downtime risk is low for rollback. Any objections?

emma: +1 for rollback. We don't want to rush a code change into prod during the window. I'll prepare the rollback PR to pin image to release-2026-03-18-9f2b and update release notes.

release-eng: also flagging the infra PR that caused the mismatch: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/998 - it's safe, but the helm overlay in prod needs the trailing-slash normalization. We'll update overlays after rollback.

nelson: steps: (1) hold promotion (releasebot / deploybot please pause), (2) pin image in kustomize/helm for this release to previous tag, (3) run one-off backfill job in prod to reconcile keys and encoding, (4) roll forward when backfill + overlay fix merged and validated in staging.

deploybot: promotion paused by user request.

emma: creating rollback PR now -> https://github.com/redwood/services/pull/4321 (pin inference-runtime image to release-2026-03-18-9f2b). Will include a short note in release notes: "Hold: keystore path normalization mismatch; rolling back to prior image while infra overlay is backfilled."

release-eng: please also add a short runbook entry so on-call knows to check s3 keys and decoding. Suggested command to validate prod keys:

```
aws s3 ls s3://redwood-keystore/prefix/keystore/ --profile prod
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-keystore/prefix/keystore/<key> - | base64 --decode | jq .
```

nelson: I'll own the one-off backfill. Plan: run job that lists keys, normalizes trailing slashes, and ensures stored value encoding matches expected (plaintext). Testing on a small prefix in prod test bucket first. Estimate 20-30m.

sarah: timeline check: rollback PR -> merge in 5-10m, deploy rollback to prod in the change window, backfill job runs immediately after, then we re-run release-check and promote when green. Sounds reasonable.

ops-bot: change window note: doing rollback counts as minor release activity, OK.

release-eng: please add a short entry in release notes and tag support for post-rollback monitoring (alert: inference-runtime error-rate).

emma: PR merged and pinned. Deploy started.

deploybot: deploy event: inference-runtime rolled back to release-2026-03-18-9f2b on prod (deployment/infra: rollout complete).

nelson: backfill job started against a small prefix (prod/normalization-test). No errors so far.

sarah: monitoring looks stable, 5xxs are down to baseline. :white_check_mark:

nelson: backfill full run completed, validated checksums/decodes. Ran additional sanity: sample keys show expected plaintext values.

release-eng: re-running release-check now.

deploybot: release-check OK now for keystore parity. No outstanding infra overlay mismatches.

emma: new plan for re-promote: after infra overlay fix merges (PR 1002), we'll re-run canary in staging for 15m then promote.

nelson: follow-ups created:
 - infra overlay fix PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1002 (prod helm overlay normalization)
 - backfill runbook doc: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/keystore-normalization (added steps and validation commands)
 - postmortem note in release notes: short blurb about hold and corrective actions.

release-eng: good. closing this thread once PR 1002 merged and re-promotion completed. Thanks all. :tada:
